gap.statement: No technical spec says how an eaten ghost returns to the ghost house before chasing again. The dev plan, capability and code cannot proceed without it.

data.summary: I wrote intent/g2b/tech-spec.md. It adds a `returning` ghost mode in `src/game.ts`, found with a breadth-first `stepToward` in `src/maze.ts`. The ghost walks to its own house cell through the door at (9,8), then goes back to chase. It covers transitions, edge cases (eaten while frightened, still returning when frightened ends, a pellet mid-return, life lost or new game) and vitest unit and integration tests. Assumptions a reader must know: a returning ghost moves one cell per tick, counts as back in the house when it stands on its own home cell, and is harmless and uneatable; its colour is a g
